stem:
Which word is a pronoun in this sentence?

Ben was late because he missed the bus.
hints: A pronoun takes the place of a noun, so you don't have to repeat a name.
Look at the second part of the sentence. Which word stands for Ben?
Names like Ben are nouns. Find the short word used instead of the name. That word is the pronoun.

solution.methodName: Ask what job the word does

steps.action: A pronoun is a word used in place of a noun, such as I, you, he, she, it, we or they.
In the second part of the sentence, "he" stands for Ben.
steps.why: Without the pronoun, the sentence would say "Ben was late because Ben missed the bus." The pronoun saves you from repeating the name.

trapNotes.Ben: Ben is a name, so it is a noun. The pronoun is the word used in place of Ben.
trapNotes.late: Late describes Ben, so it is an adjective, not a pronoun.
trapNotes.bus: Bus names a thing, so it is a noun.
